messages.subject: negating the loading of an indicator on a latent variable
parts:
If I want to add a variable to a factor but need to negate that variable (multiple it by -1), can I simply add it to a factor with a negative sign.  So, for example, will a negated version of comp2.23 be added to f2 with the following code:

f2=~comp1.12+comp1.23+comp2.12-comp2.23

Thank you,
Mark S.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: negating the loading of an indicator on a latent variable
parts:
If I want to add a variable to a factor but need to negate that variable (multiple it by -1), can I simply add it to a factor with a negative sign.  So, for example, will a negated version of comp2.23 be added to f2 with the following code:

f2=~comp1.12+comp1.23+comp2.12-comp2.23

That's something you can find out by trying it.  I tried it on the example(cfa) by changing "+ x3" to "- x3" and it does not work.  I would not expect it to work, because the "+" operator in the model syntax language is not doing arithmetic; it just means "and".

Terry

thanks,
